content.text:
Avi, write this down for when he calls… Hello, sweetheart. No, I didn't decide anything, and I won't until I've spoken to you or to the bank.

**What I came for:** I wanted to put money every month into that "S&P 500" thing for the long run, as cheaply as possible, and see what's left after costs.

**What I saw:**
- **The top of the page.** The heading was "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן", and right under it was a row of buttons all in English letters. To me, מדד is the price index on the news, not this. If I hadn't come with a task I'd have left right there.
- **The boxes.** They already had numbers in them: "סכום היום 10,000", "הפקדה חודשית 500", "שנים 10" and "תשואה בשנה 7%". I didn't touch the sliders. I don't know where that 7% comes from, and it isn't written that it's guaranteed.
- **The numbers that stuck.** "הפקדתם 70,000 ₪", and next to it "הבחירה שלכם 84,184 ₪ — נשאר לכם בעוד 10 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס". So by them, 70 thousand turns into about 84 thousand. It sounds nice, but it's all built on that 7%.
- **Who comes out cheapest.** It's "אינטראקטיב ישראל (מותג של MEXEM LTD)". I've never heard of it, and I wouldn't give them a shekel. Next comes "Interactive Brokers", also in English.
- **Our banks.** Further down, in the list on the right, they come out lower: "הפועלים 68,511", "דיסקונט 68,439", "לאומי 71,513", "מזרחי טפחות 69,201". In some of them it says that's less than the 70,000 I would put in. If I read it right, the bank takes the most. That's the one thing I really took away, and I want you to check it.

**What I skipped:**
- The coloured stripes with the 7,483, 404 and 1,273 inside them, and the dots underneath that explain the colours. I can't tell the colours apart.
- The long list of funds on the left with all the coloured labels. That's where I first saw minus numbers in red, "−533 ₪" and "−536 ₪", and I backed away from it.
- The section "מה כתוב בפרסום, מול התעריפון".
- The graph with the lines, the grey bars and "עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי". There were more minuses, like "−21.8% ב־2022" and "−12.5%". That reminded me of the fund that fell on me.

**Words I didn't understand:** ETF, UCITS, Accumulating, Dist, IE00B5BMR087, W-8BEN, "קרן מחקה", "תעודת סל", "צוברת", "מחלקת דיבידנד", "נטרול מט"ח", "דמי משמרת", "נאמן", "מול המדד", "עמלת זו על זו", "4D", "4A", and the little dotted lines under every number.

**What I couldn't read or follow:**
- The whole page is black, and some of the writing is small and grey. Even enlarged I couldn't read it, especially the explanations under the bank names.
- The lines are long, and I lost my place in the middle.

**Where I got tired:** around the third screen, at the graphs and the red minuses. That's where I stopped. I did glance at the fourth screen but didn't really read it. There are two more screens after that, and I never got to them.

**My answer:** I'm not putting money into this on my own. The page says it would come to about 84 thousand from 70, but only if that 7% really happens. The cheapest place is a company I don't know, and our banks come out lower. Come over on Shabbat and we'll look at it together, or I'll ask at the bank how much they're taking from me.
